---
name: task
description: A task managed by the TaskNotes plugin for Obsidian.
display_name_key: title
strict: false

match:
  path_glob: "TaskNotes/Tasks/**/*.md"

fields:
  title:
    type: string
    required: true
    description: "Short summary of the task."
  status:
    type: enum
    required: true
    values: [none, open, in-progress, done]
    default: open
  priority:
    type: enum
    values: [none, low, normal, high]
    default: normal
  due:
    type: date
  scheduled:
    type: date
  contexts:
    type: list
    items:
      type: string
  projects:
    type: list
    description: "Wikilinks to related project notes."
    items:
      type: link
  timeEstimate:
    type: integer
    min: 0
    description: "Estimated time in minutes."
  completedDate:
    type: date
  dateCreated:
    type: datetime
    required: true
  dateModified:
    type: datetime
  recurrence:
    type: string
  recurrence_anchor:
    type: enum
    values: [scheduled, completion]
    default: scheduled
  tags:
    type: list
    items:
      type: string
  timeEntries:
    type: list
    items:
      type: object
      fields:
        startTime:
          type: datetime
        endTime:
          type: datetime
        description:
          type: string
        duration:
          type: integer
  reminders:
    type: list
    description: "Reminder objects with id, type, offset, etc."
    items:
      type: object
      fields:
        id:
          type: string
          required: true
        type:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
        relatedTo:
          type: string
          description: "Field the reminder is relative to (e.g. 'due')."
        offset:
          type: string
          description: "ISO 8601 duration offset (e.g. '-PT1H')."
        absoluteTime:
          type: string
  blockedBy:
    type: list
    items:
      type: object
      fields:
        uid:
          type: string
          required: true
        reltype:
          type: string
        gap:
          type: string
  complete_instances:
    type: list
    items:
      type: date
  skipped_instances:
    type: list
    items:
      type: date
  icsEventId:
    type: list
    items:
      type: string
  googleCalendarEventId:
    type: string
---

# Task

This type definition describes the data schema for tasks managed by
[TaskNotes](https://github.com/callumalpass/tasknotes), an Obsidian plugin
for note-based task management.

It conforms to [mdbase-spec](https://github.com/callumalpass/mdbase-spec) v0.2.0,
a specification for typed markdown collections.

This file is automatically generated from TaskNotes settings and should not be
edited manually. Changes to TaskNotes settings (statuses, priorities, field
mappings, user fields) will cause this file to be regenerated.
